scope: Repair only the shared portable doctor static-ELF classifier and its regression tests; no registry, tool payload, MCP, SDK, CLI interface, or unrelated native solver changes.

problem.review_finding: P1: absence of PT_INTERP alone is not proof of static linkage. An ET_DYN shared object may contain PT_DYNAMIC and DT_NEEDED without PT_INTERP; skipping ldd can hide missing dependencies.
problem.false_positive: ET_DYN + no PT_INTERP + PT_DYNAMIC + DT_NEEDED was accepted as static ELF OK.
problem.related_guard: ET_REL/ET_CORE and malformed/unsupported ELF must never be accepted as static.

classifier.static_shortcut: Only ET_EXEC with PT_LOAD, nonzero e_entry, and no PT_INTERP or PT_DYNAMIC is accepted as static.
classifier.dynamic_or_ambiguous: PT_INTERP, ET_DYN, PT_DYNAMIC, or an unrecognized/unsupported ELF does not receive a static verdict; the normal fail-closed ldd path is used.
classifier.dynamic_table: For PT_DYNAMIC, parse the bounded p_offset/p_filesz region using ELF32/ELF64 entry sizes, require DT_NULL termination, and detect DT_NEEDED. Any DT_NEEDED routes to ldd; malformed, unterminated, or dependency-free PT_DYNAMIC remains ambiguous and also routes to ldd.
classifier.bounds: Validate program-header and dynamic-table ranges against file size; cap program headers at 4096 and dynamic entries at 65536; reject duplicate PT_DYNAMIC and malformed tables.

regressions.et_rel: A crafted ET_REL image with PT_LOAD but no executable entry must not take the static shortcut.
regressions.missing_needed: Compile a real ET_DYN shared object with -shared -fPIC and DT_NEEDED for a private library; verify readelf reports Type DYN, PT_DYNAMIC present, PT_INTERP absent, and DT_NEEDED present; remove the library; real host ldd must cause doctor FAIL.
regressions.static_positive: Preserve the existing real gcc -static executable positive.
regressions.dynamic_positive: Preserve the existing real GCC dynamic PIE positive.
regressions.existing_controls: Preserve the previous GNU/musl dependency listing, missing-library, malformed diagnostic, vDSO-only, static marker, doctor argument, and private-library containment controls.

local_probe.runtime: Node.js 22.16.0 for shell-level parser reproduction only
local_probe.scope: Local ELF parser reproduction; not a substitute for the exact-head Node24 CI.
